PMECRG awarded to Faculty members of NIT Rourkela!

Faculty members of NIT Rourkela were awarded the Prime Minister Early Career Research Grant (PMECRG) under the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF). Anchored under ANRF, this prestigious grant supports early-career faculty in establishing themselves as independent researchers by providing financial assistance for advanced research projects, infrastructure, and capacity building.
